panels.title: Inclusion Time Trends with Moving Average

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blockchain_operations")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "gas_used" or r["_field"] == "inclusion_time_seconds" or r["_field"] == "transaction_fee" or r["_field"] == "finalization_time_seconds")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "blockchain", "operation", "certificate_id", "gas_used", "inclusion_time_seconds", "transaction_fee", "finalization_time_seconds"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> rename(columns: {"_time": "Timestamp"})
  |> yield(name: "raw_data")
